captions: Tab. 31.2 Disaggregated life cycle inventory for the production of liquid epoxy resin (modified from Boustead 1999).
reason: Chapter 31 'Epoxy Resins' of `2007 - LCI chemicals - Althaus.pdf`, the dataset's own cited report, prints TWO inventories side by side: Tab. 31.1 (pp. 355-357) 'Life cycle inventory for the production of liquid epoxy resin based on cumulative data for the life cycle' - that is the target dataset 'epoxy resin, liquid, at plant' itself and is deliberately not selected - and Tab. 31.2 (p.358) 'Disaggregated life cycle inventory for the production of liquid epoxy resin (modified from Boustead 1999)', which is the same product modelled as a unit process: 9 technosphere exchanges (electricity, heavy fuel oil, natural gas furnace, tap water, two disposal services, chemical plant, rail and lorry transport) plus its own resources and direct emissions. Tab. 31.2 is the answer. It is also already a dataset in BAFU-2026 - 'Epoxy resin, liquid, disaggregated data, at plant' [RER], code 6ac7f2be, 9 technosphere inputs, 63 elementary flows - whose exchanges reproduce Tab. 31.2 line for line, so this is the one case in the set where BAFU itself ships both the aggregated and the disaggregated version of the same product.
